_meta.note: The notifier's strings, merged over layer zero's pack at load. Every key starts with `notify.`. `notify.ack_words` and `notify.no_words` are comma-separated single words: a reply acknowledges with one of the first and never with any of the second, so "no puedo 417" is not an acknowledgement. A translation lists its own.

strings.notify.reply_sms: Reply OK {code} when someone is on it.
strings.notify.escalated: Nobody has answered this for {minutes:.0f} minutes. {text}
strings.notify.ack_words: ok, okay, yes, yep, seen, got, going, coming, onit
strings.notify.no_words: no, not, nope, cant, cannot, unable, wont, dont, later
strings.notify.escalated_several: Nobody has answered these for {minutes:.0f} minutes. {text}
strings.notify.reply_sms_several: Reply OK to take them all, or OK and a number to take one: {codes}.
